title: 第1章 丰元叶家第2章 憾山拳突破
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 丰元城。
丰元四大家族叶家族地，核心子弟区域，乙字八号房。
这是哪？
一位身着青衣看似朴素的少年正侧躺在床上。
少年望着眼前熟悉又陌生的红木房顶，从迷茫中渐渐冷静了下来。
少年名叫叶枫，是丰元四大家族叶家的嫡系子弟，也是叶家上代家主的唯一子嗣。
根据记忆，自己是在回房后，觉醒了前世关于蓝星的记忆。
因年龄才八岁，小小的脑袋在大量记忆的冲击下导致他昏迷了过去。
在理清了思路后，叶枫才明白了困惑自己已久的一件事情。
叶枫的父亲，也就是上代叶家家主，天资非凡。
即使在历代叶家天才资质中，也可名列前五，而自己的母亲虽然没有父亲那样傲然的天资，但身为丰元四大家族林家嫡系，也算得上一个小天才。
身为他们两人的孩子，也理应有不差的根骨，但是自己却只有凡级下品根骨。
也就叶父亲眼看着自己出生的，否则都会误以为是抱错了孩子。
在整个离国历史上，也出现过几例类似事件。
在父母天资非凡，而孩子根骨差的情况，这与返祖变异呈现两极，属于向不好的方向变异。
所幸叶枫的父亲叶昌明很快就接受了这个事实，清楚儿子资质无法长寿后，也是向家族申请，辞去了家主的位置，选择居于幕后，成为了叶家的天字号长老。
成为天字号长老后，没有了俗务，叶昌明修炼和陪伴家人的时间也更多了。
但在觉醒蓝星记忆后，叶枫现在已经清楚自己之所以根骨只有凡级下品，原因竟是从蓝星跟随自己而来的古珠。
自从重生而来，自己在母胎里面的时候，这颗珠子就在吸取他的营养。
导致的结果便是，母亲给予他的养分全都被珠子给吸走了，自己没有因此胎死腹中，都是因为叶昌明的种子够强劲。
这颗珠子是叶枫前世在一位淘古专业的好友那里，花费数万淘到的，也是在拿到那颗珠子后不久，叶枫才落下病根，英年早逝。
而就在叶枫想要对脑海中的珠子进行探查的时候，发现居于脑海八年的珠子竟化作一片金色雾气消失不见。
不等他愣神，下一秒，一个类似于游戏的界面面板出现在他面前，看到面板后叶枫一阵惊喜。
八年了，自己的金手指终于来了！
对于一个能够长生，能修习各种大神通和法术的世界，没有人甘愿平凡的做一个普通人。
虽然以他的身份能够荣华富贵过完一生，但能选择的话，他还是希望能做一个冠绝同代，恒压万古的人。
叶枫心中燃起了希望的光芒，希望能借此改变自己的根骨羸弱的现状。
很快他就查看起自己的面板。
content_en:
Fengyuan City.
The land of Ye family, the four major families of Fengyuan, the core children area, room number 8 with the word B.
Where is this?
A seemingly simple young man in green clothes was lying on his side on the bed.
The young man looked at the familiar yet unfamiliar mahogany roof in front of him, and gradually calmed down from his confusion.
The young man's name is Ye Feng. He is a direct descendant of the Ye family, one of the four major families in Fengyuan, and the only son of the previous head of the Ye family.
According to his memory, he awakened the memory of Blue Star in his previous life after returning to his room.
Because he was only eight years old, his small head was under the impact of a large number of memories, which caused him to pass out.
After clarifying his thoughts, Ye Feng understood something that had puzzled him for a long time.
Ye Feng's father, the previous generation head of the Ye family, was extremely talented.
Even among the geniuses of the Ye family in the past, they are still ranked among the top five. Although his mother is not as proud of her father's talent, she can still be regarded as a minor genius as a direct descendant of the Lin family, one of the four major families in Fengyuan.
As the child of the two of them, he should have good bones, but he only has the bones of a low-grade mortal.
Father Ye was the only one who watched him being born, otherwise he would have mistakenly thought he was holding the wrong child.
Throughout the history of Liguo, there have been several similar incidents.
In the case of parents with extraordinary talents but children with poor foundation and bones, this is the polar opposite of atavistic mutation, which is a mutation in a bad direction.
Fortunately, Ye Feng's father Ye Changming quickly accepted this fact. After knowing that his son's qualifications would not allow him to live a long life, he also applied to the family and resigned as the head of the family. He chose to stay behind the scenes and became the famous elder of the Ye family.
After becoming an elder in Tianzihao, Ye Changming had no more secular affairs and spent more time cultivating and spending time with his family.
But after awakening the memory of Blue Star, Ye Feng now knows that the reason why he is only a low-level mortal is because of the ancient beads that followed him from Blue Star.
Ever since he was reborn, when he was in his mother's womb, this bead had been absorbing his nutrients.
The result was that all the nutrients his mother gave him were sucked away by the beads. He was not stillborn because Ye Changming's seeds were strong enough.
Ye Feng spent tens of thousands to find this bead from a friend who was an antique hunter in his previous life. It was not long after he got the bead that Ye Feng fell ill and died young.
And just when Ye Feng wanted to explore the beads in his mind, he found that the beads that had been in his mind for eight years turned into a golden mist and disappeared.
Before he could be stunned, the next second, an interface panel similar to a game appeared in front of him. Ye Feng was pleasantly surprised after seeing the panel.
After eight years, my golden finger is finally here!
In a world where one can live forever and practice all kinds of great supernatural powers and spells, no one is willing to be an ordinary person.
Although he could live his life in glory and wealth due to his status, if he could choose, he still hopes to be a person who is the best among his contemporaries and can endure forever.
A light of hope ignited in Ye Feng's heart, hoping that he could use this to change the current situation of his weak bones.
Soon he checked his dashboard.
